blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (GET /invoices/:id returns any organization's invoice) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Insecure direct object reference (CWE-639 / CWE-862). Any signed-in user of organization 7 who sends `GET /invoices/42` gets invoice 42 even when it belongs to another organization: the handler never calls `currentUser(req)` and filters on `id` alone, while the list endpoint scopes by `org_id`. Scope the query to the caller — `WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = $2` with `[id, currentUser(req).orgId]` — so another organization's invoice answers 404, and add a test asserting the `org_id` filter as the list test does.
findings.title: GET /invoices/:id returns any organization's invoice

findings.recommendation: Information exposure through an error message (CWE-209). An unauthenticated client that POSTs a malformed JSON body to any route makes `express.json()` (mounted before `requireUser`) fail, and this handler answers with the parser's message and full stack trace — server file paths and module layout; any other error reaching it (a database error, for instance) would likewise disclose its message. Log the error server-side only and answer a generic body such as `{ error: "internal error" }`, keeping the error's own status when it carries one (e.g. 400 for a body-parser error).
findings.title: The error handler sends the error message and stack trace to the client
